item.title: deadmau5 Is Expanding His Family in the Most Purr-ecious Way — by Adopting a New Cat He Helped
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host's voice takes over]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard. Today, we're talking about a very special addition to deadmau5's family. The electronic artist, known for his love of cats, has just announced that he's adopting a new feline friend - meet Cathulhu, a 3-year-old tabby with a grumpy face and a name inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's creepy entity Cthulhu."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Deadmau5 visited the Humane Society of Oakville, Milton & Halton in Ontario, Canada, where he met Cathulhu. He even shared a video of the kitty rolling around and enjoying some scritches from the artist. But what's even more amazing is that deadmau5 had previously donated $30,000 to the shelter after they rescued 27 felines in need of medical care."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Deadmau5 has always been a cat lover and a supporter of adopting from animal shelters. In fact, he's worked with the Toronto Humane Society in the past and has spoken about the importance of rescuing pets. As he said in a previous interview, 'I make it a point to adopt versus getting that handcrafted rare cat as a showpiece, because I think rescues are... somewhere in their little, tiny brains, they know [you saved them].'"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Cathulhu is joining deadmau5's existing cat family, which includes Dizzy, Dolly, and Peanut. And it looks like the new addition is already getting plenty of love and attention. As deadmau5's content director, Leah Sems, commented on the post, 'New king of the castle!' Welcome to the family, Cathulhu!"
[Upbeat music fades back in]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
